description: PM-4 sandbox Plan Editor. No fixture: the scenario starts on the real main menu, picks recon_stomps plus the editor's own Hammer and Anvil zone picker, and presses the Plan Editor button. Asserts the whole session contract — plan_editor lands in meta.game_config, Player 2's units are gone, Formations runs for real for the target army while the absent seat is auto-confirmed, the deploy roll-off resolves without a dialog with Player 1 as Defender, and the PLAN EDITOR banner (with its Exit to Menu button) is on screen. One unit is deployed down the real player path (unit list click + board click) and the rest in bulk; with every unit deployed the phase STILL reads DEPLOYMENT, proving PhaseManager's hold-open guard suppresses all three completion emitters. The final steps clear the flag and show END_DEPLOYMENT then advances, so the hold is attributable to the flag and not to a stuck phase.
